task_title: GitReins tier1 build arm must not grade a missing dependency as FAIL
task_criteria: 1. scripts/guard-build.sh exists and, run in a tree with no node_modules, prints 'GITREINS_SKIP: build=dependencies not installed' and exits 0. 2. Run in a tree WITH node_modules, it runs npm run build and propagates npm's exit code. 3. .gitreins/config.yaml routes both guards.build_command and pipeline stage id 'build' through scripts/guard-build.sh.

items.detail: All three sub-requirements verified by execution, not inspection. (1) scripts/guard-build.sh exists (2387 bytes, mode -rwxrwxr-x). Run in an isolated tree with no node_modules (/tmp/gb-nonm, script copied to scripts/): stdout was 'skipped: dependencies not installed (node_modules absent — run npm ci)' followed by 'GITREINS_SKIP: build=dependencies not installed (node_modules absent — run npm ci)', rc=0; `grep -c 'GITREINS_SKIP: build=dependencies not installed'` returned 1 (EXACT_STRING_PRESENT). (2) WITH node_modules, in the real repo: `bash scripts/guard-build.sh` -> 'build ok — npm run build exited 0', EXIT_CODE=0. Exit-code propagation proven in /tmp/gb-fail (node_modules dir present, package.json build="exit 7"): output 'build FAILED — npm run build exited 7', EXIT_CODE=7 — npm's own rc is propagated, not swallowed (scripts/guard-build.sh:52-60 captures rc then `exit "$rc"`). (3) .gitreins/config.yaml:22 `build_command: bash scripts/guard-build.sh` under `guards:` (line 1), and .gitreins/config.yaml:67 `run: bash scripts/guard-build.sh` under `pipeline:` (line 51) step `id: build` (line 61) — both live YAML keys, not comments. Test evidence: `npx vitest run tests/ci/ci005-precommit-hook.test.ts` -> 'Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 7 passed (7)', EXIT_CODE=0; AC4 at tests/ci/ci005-precommit-hook.test.ts:180-199 asserts both config routes and that the wrapper body contains `npm run build`. [resolution 0.00; scripts/guard-build.sh]
